name: Downloads
description: An inbox in Ledger for files sent from your browser with the Send to Ledger extension (included): bank statements, bills, CSVs. Forward them to the Auto sort module or Ledger's CSV import, download, archive or delete them.

fields.label: Delete sent and archived files after (days)
fields.help: 0 keeps them until you delete them. Files waiting in the inbox are never deleted automatically.
